verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for an inference API, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The '/v1/' path in the SDK warming note is incidental, and 'track multiple versions' refers to fine-tuned model uploads, not API versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
